nodes.name: GitHexa.ts
nodes.summary: Hexagon entry point of the git domain package: wires repositories, the GitHub token resolver factory, GitServices and the GitAdapter, and exposes the adapter as the IGitPort.

nodes.name: GitHexa
nodes.summary: Hexa class that builds the git domain's repositories and services on construction, initializes the GitAdapter with ports from other hexas, and returns it as the public git port.

nodes.name: GitProviderService.ts
nodes.summary: Application service managing git providers (GitHub/GitLab): CRUD, credential checks, branch/PR operations, repository listing and marketplace checks, delegating to provider clients and resolved repo instances.

nodes.name: GitProviderService
nodes.summary: Large service encapsulating all git provider operations: persistence via IGitProviderRepository, auth checks, owner readings, branch creation/deletion, pull request upsert, branch comparison and file listing.

nodes.name: GitRepoService.ts
nodes.summary: Application service wrapping IGitRepoRepository with git repository lookups, tracking updates, adoption between providers and marketplace-aware queries.

nodes.name: GitRepoService
nodes.summary: Service exposing repository CRUD and query methods (by id, owner/repo, branch, provider, organization) plus tracked-repo updates and adoption.

nodes.name: GitServices.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregator that instantiates and exposes the git domain's application services (provider, repo, commit, resolved repo) plus the repo factory and GitHub App repository.

nodes.name: GitServices
nodes.summary: Service locator building GitProviderService, GitRepoService, GitCommitService and ResolvedGitRepoService from the git repositories bundle.

nodes.name: GitAdapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implementation of the IGitPort exposed to other domains: wires all git use cases and delayed jobs, and delegates each port method (providers, repos, branches, commits, PRs, files, GitHub Apps, tracking) to its use case or service.

nodes.name: GitAdapter
nodes.summary: Port adapter that instantiates every git use case once dependencies (accounts, deployments, job queues) are set, then forwards ~40 port operations to them.

nodes.name: FetchFileContentDelayedJob.ts
nodes.summary: BullMQ-backed delayed job that fetches file content from a git repository asynchronously, keeping per-job completion callbacks in memory.

nodes.name: FetchFileContentDelayedJob
nodes.summary: Delayed job class that queues fetch-file-content jobs, resolves the repo and file via GetFileFromRepoUseCase in the worker, and invokes or clears registered callbacks on completion/failure.

nodes.name: GitCommitService.ts
nodes.summary: Thin service persisting git commit records through IGitCommitRepository.

nodes.name: GitCommitService
nodes.summary: Service with a single addCommit method saving a GitCommit via the commit repository.

nodes.name: ResolvedGitRepoService.ts
nodes.summary: Single path turning a stored GitRepo into an IGitRepo client, caching providers and resolved repo instances in a short 10s reuse window so rotated credentials take effect quickly.

nodes.name: ResolvedGitRepoService
nodes.summary: Service resolving GitRepo records into IGitRepo instances via IGitRepoFactory, with short-lived windowed caches for providers and repos and expiry eviction.

nodes.name: providerHostUrl.ts
nodes.summary: Utility computing the host URL a git provider reaches (github.com for GitHub, stored URL or gitlab.com for GitLab).

nodes.name: providerHostUrl
nodes.summary: Returns the host URL for a git provider: always github.com for GitHub, else the stored URL or the source default.

nodes.name: AddGitProviderUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Member use case adding a git provider to an organization after validating display name and credentials (token or GitHub App) and optionally probing them.

nodes.name: AddGitProviderUseCase
nodes.summary: Use case validating auth method and credentials, optionally verifying them against the provider, then persisting the provider via GitProviderService.

nodes.name: AddGitRepoUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Member use case adding a git repository under a provider, handling duplicate detection, host-prefixed owners and adoption of CLI-recorded repos from tokenless providers on the same host.

nodes.name: AddGitRepoUseCase
nodes.summary: Use case that checks for existing repos, adopts adoptable ones from unauthenticated providers on the same host, and otherwise creates the repo, notifying deployments.

nodes.name: isAdoptableBy
nodes.summary: Decides whether a repo held by an unauthenticated provider can be adopted by an authenticated provider on the same git host.

nodes.name: CheckBranchExistsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case checking live whether a branch exists for a git repo on its provider.

nodes.name: CheckBranchExistsUseCase
nodes.summary: Use case resolving the repo's provider and querying it for branch existence, without caching.

nodes.name: CheckDirectoryExistenceUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case verifying that a directory path exists on a given branch of a tracked git repository.

nodes.name: CheckDirectoryExistenceUseCase
nodes.summary: Use case validating inputs, loading the repo, resolving it to an IGitRepo client and checking directory existence, wrapping failures in DirectoryExistenceCheckFailedError.

nodes.name: CheckProviderAuthUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Member use case checking whether a git provider's stored credentials still authenticate.

nodes.name: CheckProviderAuthUseCase
nodes.summary: Use case delegating to GitProviderService.checkProviderAuth for an organization's provider.
